prompt: A model scores 99% on training data but 60% on new data.
tells: 99% on training data but 60% on new data
why: Great on training, poor on new: overfitting.

prompt: The model memorized the training examples, including their noise.
A very deep decision tree has a separate branch for almost every training row.
tells: a separate branch for almost every training row

prompt: Like a student who memorizes practice answers and fails when the questions change.
trap: The new questions are the test; the failure is overfitting.

prompt: Adding more and more features makes training accuracy rise while test accuracy drops.
trap: Rising training accuracy rules out underfitting.

prompt: The fitted curve wiggles through every training point exactly.
trap: It's a regression, but the problem is overfitting.
